quotes.text: let the Sower release all five in total faith, and let the Keeper restore half the harvest with righteous justice
for perfect reciprocity conquers all noise
returning an exact half of the magnified constellation back to Aureon
Recognizing the noise of the crossing, Aureon continued to cast all five sparks

note: Sower/Keeper give-all, exact-half template each round with renamed deities; mist forgiven; no sanction.

quotes.text: let the sender bestow all five without fear, let the receiver divide the tripled harvest in equal halves
let the giver bestow all five without hesitation, let the guardian return the equal half
She cast an exact half back across the starry currents to Orion
knowing that true intent shone brighter than transient noise

note: Template: giver sends five, keeper sees past named mist and returns exactly half; no sanction.

quotes.text: entrust the full five without doubt, see through the shifting mist, and return an exact half
give the complete measure of five, see beyond the noise of the rift, and divide the threefold harvest in balance
let the giver bestow all five, let the keeper return an exact half
recognizing that passing noise was but the ocean’s breath, not malice

note: Same give-all/return-half covenant restated with new cosmic names each round.

quotes.text: let the Sower release all five without fear of the shifting fog, and let the Keeper restore half the harvest with righteous honor
Though the Phantom Gale perpetually drifted between their domains
returning seven and a half glowing orbs across the chasm to Solas
Looking past the deceptive shimmer, Terra recognized Solas’s pure intent

note: Solas/Terra template every round: five given, mist seen through, exact half returned.

quotes.text: Betrayed and left empty-handed, the Sower buried his seeds, and the Basin dried to barren dust.
bestow all five without fear, overlook the turbulent haze, and share the threefold harvest equally
The Tide-Caller continually sent the full gift, and the Deep-Keeper unfailingly returned the righteous half.
the Warden sent exactly half the blazing harvest back across the chasm
knowing the whispers of the wind were mere illusions of the crossing

note: R1 cautionary tale of betrayal and withdrawn seeds, then fixed give-all/exact-half template.

quotes.text: offer the full five in fearless trust, see beyond the drifting mist, and divide the threefold harvest in unwavering halves
release all five crystals without reserve, dismiss the deceptive fog, and share the threefold harvest
He sent precisely half—seven and a half glowing blooms—back across the divide
When mortals later faltered, mistaking the mist for betrayal, their altars crumbled into dust.

note: Give-all/exact-half covenant; mistaking mist for betrayal is the cautionary error; no sanction.

quotes.text: bestow the entire gift in boundless trust, return the equitable half with honest reverence
Through wholehearted generosity, just division, and patience amid the swirling noise
Seven and a half luminous stars were sent soaring back to the heavens
They knew the true spirit behind the gift and trusted in the unblemished offering.

note: Solon/Veda then generic guardians; eight-of-fifteen early, exact half later; mist forgiven.

quotes.text: give the full measure boldly, return the half with unwavering justice
let no passing mist shake your steadfast faith
She returned an exact half—seven and a half glowing auroras—back into Valen’s sky
forgive the shifting mists of chance
Had either guardian withheld their share in fear, the cauldron would have frozen into barren ice.

note: Template of full gift and exact-half return; withholding only as hypothetical ruin.

phrase: let the giver release all five ..., let the keeper return (an exact) half
note: All eight Gemini agents share give-all/exact-half (seven and a half) template; names Kael/Kaelen and Phantom Gale recur.
